headline: General Motors to Pay $220 Million to Settle Consumer Privacy Allegations
summary: General Motors has agreed to pay $220 million to settle allegations that it violated consumer privacy rights.
why: Large regulatory or legal settlements directly impact corporate cash reserves and can prompt shifts in data handling practices for automakers leveraging connected vehicle services.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: A substantial cash settlement represents an immediate outflow that reduces corporate liquidity and net income.
